label: Project country identifier
definition: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 identifier used across project sources

label: Season year
definition: Calendar year in which the October-April season ends

label: Season start date
notes: Always 1 October of the preceding calendar year.

label: Season end date
notes: Always 30 April of the season year.

label: Growing-season precipitation
definition: Sum of country-area mean daily precipitation over October-April
notes: Country-area summary; not maize-area weighted and not a gauge-only measurement.

label: Observed days
definition: Number of daily country summaries included in the seasonal total
notes: Expected value is 212 or 213 depending on leap-year coverage.
